title: Verify: test script includes the tracked-dependency guard
summary: Unit test reads package.json and asserts the guard precedes vitest.
description: Unit test that proves REQ3: the package.json test script runs the guard before vitest.
acceptance_criteria: scripts.test includes the guard script path.

steps.symbol: new: it('test script runs the guard before vitest')
steps.action: Read ../package.json via readFileSync(new URL('../package.json', import.meta.url)), JSON.parse, take scripts.test; expect it toContain 'scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts' and expect indexOf(guard) < indexOf('vitest run') and toContain '&&'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/testScriptGuard.test.ts
